overloads.semanticRole: The Is editing text command returns True if the user is entering values in an input form object, and False in all other cases.

constraints: Only meaningful with these form object types: input (enterable or non-enterable listbox), and combo box; with any other object type it always returns False.
Cannot be used with 4D Write Pro or 4D View Pro areas.
Intended for use inside code triggered by the On Before Keystroke form event, to distinguish actual text entry from shortcut-key handling (e.g. listbox scrolling).
